decisions.reason: It is tightly aligned with the firm's psychiatric and therapeutic capabilities, and another year of experience should further strengthen learning and integration into core mental-health services.

The workshop still fits the firm's practical therapy and production know-how, but because custom furniture remains more peripheral to core care activities it carries a higher withdrawal risk than the clinical and support services.

Outpatient sociotherapy is very close to the firm's established support model, so existing knowledge, staff expertise, and internal development capacity make continued refinement and retention likely.
Senior-living counseling is closely connected to the firm's eldercare business and facility network, giving it strong strategic fit and good scope for learning from client demand.

Meal delivery for seniors is related to the firm's eldercare offer and client base, but it is operationally somewhat less central than its therapeutic and residential services, so it remains moderately more vulnerable.
